copies.apps/mobile/lib/epub-content.ts: htmlToText here keeps a line break after each block, which the reader's text-to-speech splits sentences on; Prelum's htmlToText flattens all white space to one space, and web work never touches apps/mobile (CLAUDE.md, hard rule 2)
copies.apps/web/public/_headers: not by hand: the web build's site-runtime-headers writes it from Foxing's registry entry, the same entry workers/header-set.ts gives buildSecurityHeaders; committed so the /assets/* and /islands/* cache rules can be read
